text: REJECT: the new `<param name="movedHeadPin">` on `CheckBenchAsync` documents only one of its nine parameters, which raises CS1573 (missing param tags) when XML docs are generated, and that fails a warnings-as-errors build. I couldn't build the project or see the elided parts of `CheckAsync`, so that build break is a risk rather than a confirmed failure. The refactor otherwise looks behaviour-preserving, but the complexity estimate is borderline (my rough count puts `CheckAsync` at about 15, depending on the elided middle section).
